Africa: UN Chief Urges Talks On Global Ai Safety Framework, Warns of Historic Shift in Power: [UN News] UN Secretary-General António Guterres on Monday called on Member States to begin discussions on a multilateral framework for managing the risks of artificial intelligence (AI), warning that the technology is driving "the biggest transfer of power in the history of humankind". http://newsfeed.facilit8.network/TWRwYt #ArtificialIntelligence #AIGovernance #GlobalSafety #PowerShift #UNChief
